summary: The federal minimum wage is $7.25 an hour and has been since July 24, 2009.
realLife: The Fair Labor Standards Act sets the federal minimum wage at $7.25 per hour, effective July 24, 2009.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, Minimum Wage: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/minimum-wage
inGame: the minimum wage in force (the laws module's wage floor, read by the constituent-cases wage complaint) against the hire row's pay. needs: pay on the first hire row.

turns.what: A first job that pays above the floor, in a place with a higher minimum.
A first job that pays below the floor and becomes a wage complaint later.
turns.pulledBy: the wage floor against the pay
turns.writesBack: a constituent case, read at office hours
